lines.text: Going to Jerusalem, Jesus told the twelve the Son of Man would be delivered to the chief priests and scribes.
Jesus said He would be delivered to the Gentiles, mocked, flogged, crucified, and raised on the third day.
A mother knelt before Jesus and asked for her sons to sit at His right and left.
Jesus asked if the brothers could drink His cup, they answered "We can," and the ten were pleased with them.
Among the disciples, whoever wants to be great must be a servant, since the Son of Man came to rule.
